name: Viessmann
verdict: The sponsor is the Viessmann Generations Group, the Viessmann family's company, which owns the Viessmann brand (the heating business was combined with Carrier Global in 2024 and uses the brand under licence). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Announced as a new Official Partner of the Germany SailGP Team on 15 April 2026 (viessmann.group press release). German family company, no state link, no qualifying human-rights finding -> none.
